title: Transfer Reconciliation Mismatch
app: Monarch Money, Copilot Money, Plaid-connected accounts, Plaid investments, and brokerage CSV exports ingested into Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=plaid:transaction transaction_type=transfer
| stats sum(amount_usd) as transfer_total_usd, dc(account_id) as account_count by transfer_group_id
| where account_count<2
| sort transfer_total_usd
description: Uses Plaid transfer transactions telemetry to monitor transfer groups missing a matching source or destination in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for move-money events that may not have reconciled cleanly, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Plaid transfer transactions data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates transfer groups missing a matching source or destination so you can spot move-money events that may not have reconciled cleanly before it becomes annoying.
